scenes.title_cn: 开场：今天用机顶闪光灯配合哈苏，实现…
scenes.title_en: Opening: today a speedlight plus Hasselbla…
scenes.context: 全域快门突破同步速度限制。
sentences: 今天用机顶闪光灯配合哈苏，实现阳光下极致压光的效果。
Today a speedlight plus Hasselblad achieves extreme fill-flash in sunlight.
extreme fill-flash（极致压光）
哈苏搭配全域快门，可以同步到1/2000秒甚至更高。
Hasselblad's global shutter syncs to 1/2000s or faster.
global shutter（全域快门）
让闪光灯在烈日下也能压住太阳光。
Flash can beat the sun even at high noon.
beat the sun（压住太阳）
scenes.speak: Today a speedlight plus Hasselblad achieves extreme fill-flash in sunlight. Hasselblad's global shutter syncs to 1/2000s or faster. Flash can beat the sun even at high noon.

scenes.title_cn: 压光原理：压光的核心是压低背景曝光，…
scenes.title_en: The principle: fill-flash's core is undere…
sentences: 压光的核心是压低背景曝光，让闪光灯成为画面的主角。
Fill-flash's core is underexposing the background so flash is the hero.
underexpose the background（压低背景）
先把ISO降到最低，快门提到同步速度上限，光圈根据景深需要收小。
Drop ISO to minimum, raise shutter to the sync limit, stop down the aperture.
sync speed limit（同步速度上限）
让背景欠曝，再用闪光灯把主体照亮。
Let the background go dark, then flash lights the subject.
separate subject and background（主体背景分离）
paraphrase: sync speed limit（同步速度上限
sync speed limit（同步速度上限
scenes.speak: Fill-flash's core is underexposing the background so flash is the hero. Drop ISO to minimum, raise shutter to the sync limit, stop down the aperture. Let the background go dark, then flash lights the subject.

scenes.title_cn: 实操环节：把闪光灯设置成ETTL，用…
scenes.title_en: In practice: set flash to ETTL with high-s…
sentences: 把闪光灯设置成ETTL，用高速同步，哈苏的全局快门直接同步。
Set flash to ETTL with high-speed sync; the global shutter syncs directly.
high-speed sync（高速同步）
快门放到1/2000秒，ISO到50，光圈放到f8。
Shutter 1/2000s, ISO 50, aperture f/8.
ISO 50, f/8（参数设置）
背景被压暗，主体被闪光灯照亮，画面立刻有了层次。
The background darkens, the subject is lit, and the frame instantly gains depth.
gains depth（有了层次）
scenes.speak: Set flash to ETTL with high-speed sync; the global shutter syncs directly. Shutter 1/2000s, ISO 50, aperture f/8. The background darkens, the subject is lit, and the frame instantly gains depth.

scenes.title_cn: 哈苏全域快门的选择逻辑：其他相机想在…
scenes.title_en: Why global shutter: other cameras fighting…
scenes.context: 全域快门兼具功率与画质。
sentences: 其他相机想压光，要么用高速同步损失功率，要么用ND滤镜损失画质。
Other cameras either lose flash power with HSS or quality with ND filters.
HSS vs ND（高速同步vs滤镜）
全域快门不损失闪光灯功率，画质和功率双双兼顾。
The global shutter loses no power—quality and output both preserved.
no power loss（不损失功率）
paraphrase: HSS vs ND（高速同步vs滤镜
HSS vs ND（高速同步vs滤镜
scenes.speak: Other cameras either lose flash power with HSS or quality with ND filters. The global shutter loses no power—quality and output both preserved.

scenes.title_cn: 总结：全域快门+闪光灯=极致压光。适…
sentences: 全域快门加闪光灯等于极致压光。
Global shutter plus flash equals extreme fill-flash.
the formula（公式）
适合阳光强烈的外拍场景，把背景压成深蓝天空或黑背景。
Best for harsh-sun outdoor shoots, compressing backgrounds into deep-blue sky or black.
cinematic look（电影感效果）
scenes.speak: Global shutter plus flash equals extreme fill-flash. Best for harsh-sun outdoor shoots, compressing backgrounds into deep-blue sky or black.

practice: Underexpose the background so flash is the hero.
Drop ISO, raise shutter to the sync limit, stop down.
No power loss like HSS, no quality loss like ND.
pitfalls: Meter the flash like a steady light.
Underexpose the background first, then add flash.
先压背景曝光，闪光灯再补主体。
Use HSS and accept the power loss.
Use the global shutter for full-power high-speed sync.
全域快门超高快门不损失功率。
Rely on ND filters in the sun.
Global shutter keeps quality and power together.
ND损失画质，全域快门双兼顾。
Expect the same on any camera.
This experience comes from the global shutter.
只有全域快门能兼顾功率与画质。
shifts: 说压光只会说 fill flash
用 extreme fill-flash（极致压光）、underexpose the background（压低背景）、the hero（主角）
用 global shutter（全域快门）、sync speed（同步速度）、1/2000s（同步速度）
用 HSS power loss（高速同步功率损失）、ND quality loss（滤镜画质损失）、both preserved（双双兼顾）
